items.hook: The Wizard of Lemuria is a fantasy novel by American writer Lin Carter, the first book of his Thongor series set on the fictional ancient lost continent of Lemuria.
items.body: The author's first published novel, it was initially issued in paperback by Ace Books in 1965. Bring it up somewhere. Watch the reaction.
